findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 23 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 129 questions numbered 1-129; by section: 23.1 12, 23.2 9, 23.3 34, 23.4 18, 23.5 20, 23.6 15, 23.7 11, 23.8 4, 23.9 6. Keys: {'a': 32, 'b': 32, 'c': 33, 'd': 32}.

Covers every section 23.1-23.9 in order (carbonyl group, preparation of aldehydes and ketones, structure and reactivity, nucleophilic addition of HCN, hydride and 2,4-DNPH, Tollens', Fehling's and iodoform tests, carboxylic acids and their preparation, reactions of the acidic H, of -OH, reduction and oxidation, relative acidities, esters, acyl chlorides and hydrolysis of chlorides). Numericals (pKa/Ka, oxidation numbers, mole ratios with molar masses stated in the question) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: ethanal from ethanol, HCHO is methanal and formalin smells pungent, 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, 2,4-DNPH and the orange hydrazone, sodium ethanoate from propanone in the iodoform test, ethanol is first oxidised to ethanal, CH₃COOH + NaHCO₃, charge delocalised over -COO⁻, +I of CH₃ (not -I of H), ethyl ethanoate more volatile; the '14 days' figure and the phenyl ethanoate fragrance are avoided.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
